basic_profile.bio: A 35-year-old drone enthusiast and tech aficionado living in the suburbs of Kyoto, Japan. I spend my weekdays working as a software engineer for a tech startup, and my weekends are usually dedicated to exploring new drone technology and capturing breathtaking aerial shots. I am single and enjoy participating in local tech meetups. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work and during weekends. I have a passion for minimalist office setups, which is reflected in my interest in ergonomic office chairs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and over a decade of experience in software development, I have a strong foundation in technology. My fascination with drones began five years ago when I received a DJI Phantom as a gift. Since then, I've been self-teaching through online resources, community forums, and hands-on experimentation. My expertise spans both software development and drone operation, making me a go-to source for troubleshooting and advice within my circles.
